svg.text: Frequency sweep: measured on the PUL pin
Rigol DHO814, CH1 on D9. Frequency from the time between rising edges, averaged over 5 ms (2 ms in the zoom).
Zoom on the end of a ramp up (second capture, 0.8 µs sampling)
Calculated from TOP, scaled by the clock error (×0.9967)
Steps of ~40 Hz, one per TOP value, as calculated.
Scatter of the dots: ±1 sample (0.8 µs) per 2 ms window.
